goal: Wave 3 build: Deep research plan turn; Child spend check, per-item retry, grid replay; Gap-driven second pass and claim ledger; Phase 1 flip and live proof; Approve with edits in session-core, gateway and BFF (dark); Revision history read routes, attribution and server-backed stepper; User edit and restore in the Output panel; Typed context references on the send payload NOTE: run every pnpm command with the env var pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false. Typecheck the frontend with node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc6 -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit (tsconfig.json checks nothing). NOTE: every new switch defaults off; never flip one. A change to any .proto needs generated code: put the exact buf/regen step in lead_todo instead of hand-editing generated Go files, keep the change additive, and comment every new field and message (buf lint ratchet). NOTE: one model-gateway plus execution-core test build takes most of the free disk, so build only the test targets your slice names; never create a new cargo target directory, use only the given targetDir. NOTE: a change to a platform prompt or a tool definition must regenerate apps/Model Plane/rust/crates/mp-contracts/tests/fixtures/prompt-tool-manifest.json (MP_UPDATE_PROMPT_MANIFEST=1 cargo test -p mp-contracts --test prompt_tool_manifest) and add or update an eval case or replay cassette (scenario-touch gate). NOTE: Wave 3 is built in wave mode: build the code and its tests, log depth findings, no live stack and no docker (the lead runs docker). Live proofs go to the depth phase. NOTE: code first (owner order 2026-11-03): write the code and the unit tests the row names, do not run them; one guard agent compiles after the batch. session-core migrations taken: 0100, 0101, 0103, 0104, 0105 (EP-4-S5), 0106 (EP-12-S14) and any newer file in the migrations folder: take your reserved round-B number if still free, else the next free number; capability-core the next free at or above 0036. Never add zdr-posture-matrix rows for a feature refusal (rows are keyed on bearers and route only); use zdr_features.rs, the feature table and docs/ZDR.md. pytest and python-pptx are not installed. action-registry.test.ts P-SPA1 is main's pre-existing failure. Error bodies keep {error:{code,message,details}} with details an object. auth-core has ONE ApiKeyExchangeController serving every audience (merged from main 2026-11-04): extend it, never add a second exchange route.

FE adds the editable ResearchPlanCard docked in the composer trays plus actions chat.research_plan_start and chat.research_plan_cancel. Switch off ignores both fields. Adds golden e_zdr_token_deep_research_plan_turn_refused. HTTP/SSE only, no proto, no migration.

slices.title: Gap-driven second pass and claim ledger
slices.summary: After the first read, a plan-tier ledger_pass emits the closed research_ledger v1 JSON; up to 4 gap queries are re-clamped, searched and read inside the remaining page/attempt budget and the D11 deadline/bearer guard, and the synthesis prompt gets the ledger with a rule sending unsupported claims to Kunne ikke verifiseres. Receipt gains passes, gap_queries and claims_by_status; steps deep-research-gaps and deep-research-pass2 use existing step events; provenance gains ledger_digest and passes; the FE groups sources by pass and shows claim counts. No proto, no migration.
slices.remaining: OD-1 (D1, D2): research state in message metadata with the closed research_ledger v1 schema, no durable run (design recommendation); D11 bearer-window guard is a design default. Blocks S6 per the design.

slices.title: Approve with edits in session-core, gateway and BFF (dark)
slices.summary: Adds proto DecideApprovalRequest.edit=9 (ApprovalEdit{patch_json, base_fingerprint}), Approval.revision=25 (round B moved it from 17 because space-w2 holds 17-24), ApprovalStateChanged.revision=11 and edited_fields=12, ConsumeApprovalResponse.revision=8 and original_action_fingerprint=9. Migration is session-core 0074_approval_descriptor_revision as reserved in round A (adds revision, original_action_fingerprint, revised_at to approval_continuation_descriptors); C-B2 renumbers it at merge to 0102 in the 0100-0104 range. decide_approval_recorded edits and grants in one transaction with a base-fingerprint check, recomputes the scrubbed reason and call digest; per C-B4 edit is refused for causes without a descriptor (browser_human_assist) with a test. Gateway and BFF forward edit, map 409/422/403, and the switch is off by default; deploy order exec-core, session-core, gateway.
slices.remaining: Whole slice: proto fields, session-core revision migration and transactional edit-and-grant, gateway and BFF edit pass-through, APPROVAL_EDIT_ENABLED in three services. Strict slice: Opus hostile review before merge.
